summary: Recorded the stale-configuration safety account into run state (it had been submitted once but was not applied): bound to experiment 161fc9455ca947cd80cc76048bf33653-experiment with receipt 1766eefaf1f14339ad1cff36e02a7c33 events 9-12, where the restarted node led with the snapshot's three-voter configuration, acknowledged a write held by only two of five voters, and a leader elected afterwards from the configuration in force lacked that payload; added the matching behavior entry. The authority-transition receipt could not be cited because its run ended with exit code 1 (a later test in the same file failed after the authority events were emitted), so I made the harness tolerant of the restarted node already leading and queued a fresh experiment for that question instead of treating the failed run as a witness.
